title: BEACON CAP profile — base (CAP v1.2 and nothing more)
description: The default CAP_PROFILE. It deliberately adds ZERO rules on top of schemas/cap-v1.2.schema.json, which has already been applied and passed by the time this rule set runs (ADR-036 §1: buildCapAlert → base schema → PROFILE rule set → sink). Shipping it as a real file rather than special-casing 'no profile' in code keeps one code path for every deployment and lets the shipped-config test validate every id CAP_PROFILE_IDS offers. A deployment with no downstream alerting authority uses this and makes no profile claim.
$comment: Rules are NEVER invented in this directory. Any rule added here must carry the verbatim requirement text and a citation of the published specification it was transcribed from — see ipaws.schema.json for the pattern.
